meaning: market rebound, recovery after a fall

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an object bouncing back and for a setback followed by a renewed upswing.

exampleSentences.english: After falling for several days, the stock market finally had a rebound today.
exampleSentences.traditional: 股市跌咗幾日，今日終於有反彈。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gu2 si5 dit3 zo2 gei2 jat6 gam1 jat6 zung1 jyu1 jau5 faan2 daan6

english.note: Use this when prices or a market recover after falling.

exampleSentences.english: After falling for several days, the stock market finally had a rally today.
exampleSentences.traditional: 股市跌咗幾日之後，今日終於出現反彈。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gu2 si5 dit3 zo2 gei2 jat6 zi1 hau6 gam1 jat6 zung1 jyu1 ceot1 jin6 faan2 daan6
